verdict.rationale: Eliminated all banned vi.mock/jest.mock stubs. InMemoryLedgerStorage passes the shared 4-gate contract suite with structuredClone isolation, CAS versioning, and snapshot rollback. Property-based & metamorphic tests verify exact cent conservation and codec invertibility across 250 seeded runs, and Mulberry32 + VirtualClock chaos simulations prove atomic rollback and post-commit idempotency in 0ms of wall-clock sleep.
